Messages.Author: Bryan Nelson
Messages.Body:
Are tainted vitaes cummulative? If so, and I have two tainted vitaes
that my prey has placed on a vampire, and on my turn I want to bleed
with that vampire, and he only has one blood on him. Can I still bleed
with that vampire or do I have to be able to burn the required blood to
be able to bleed that methusuleh.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Bryan Nelson wrote:
> Are tainted vitaes cummulative? If so, and I have two tainted vitaes

Yes.

> that my prey has placed on a vampire, and on my turn I want to bleed
> with that vampire, and he only has one blood on him. Can I still bleed
> with that vampire or do I have to be able to burn the required blood to
> be able to bleed that methusuleh.

You can bleed. Tainted Vitae doesn't say "burn an extra blood *to* bleed",
it says "burn an additional blood when he attempts to bleed".

So, he has to attempt to bleed before he burns the blood (not the other
way around). And, as always, he ignores burn blood effects in excess of
his current blood supply.
